After freeing the repository's own declared-disposable gate roots and temp directories, the bounded run reported 3.

residualFailures.evidence: the identical 2 failures reproduce in a baseline worktree at commit d6c366c; the suite reads R3-L0C-R research artifacts and imports no module P2-D2 changed

tests: the real cold-recovered chain passes and the test root is safely cleaned
residualFailures.evidence: P2-D2 C2's §6.6 separated truncation facts grew the Capsule's essential metadata floor by ~120 bytes, and the P2-D1 gate's 4096-byte fixture budget was calibrated to the smaller baseline floor, leaving no room for a single event. The gate's fixture budget was raised to 8192 (still far below the product ceiling) with a documented note, and the test now PASSES. No product contract was weakened: the whole-byte budget, the separated truncation facts and the product ceiling are all unchanged.

archivedFamily.reason: §15.1: test/r3l0ciarlcf_gates.test.ts and its family have an unsafe isolated-mutation path in shared Windows workspaces; they import only `scripts/`, never `src/`, so no P2-D2 change can affect them

environmentLimitation: the C: volume was at 100% (1.2-1.9 GB free) during part of the regression. The first-party DSH gates each copy a full DSH tree (~1.5 GB) into a test-owned home, so they are unusually sensitive to free space and to concurrency. Every failure was re-verified in isolation and, where it reproduced, against the baseline worktree.
